name: inotify_init
description: inotify_init() initializes a new inotify instance and returns a file descriptor associated with a new inotify event queue. inotify_init1() performs the same function but allows specifying flags to set behaviors like non-blocking or close-on-exec.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to modify behavior, such as IN_NONBLOCK for non-blocking operation or IN_CLOEXEC for close-on-exec

return_value.failure: Returns -1 and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: An invalid value was specified in flags (for inotify_init1)
The user limit on the total number of inotify instances has been reached or the per-process limit on the number of open file descriptors has been reached
The system-wide limit on the total number of open files has been reached

versions: Linux 2.6.13 for inotify_init, Linux 2.6.27 for inotify_init1
